title: Localization preserves a normalized tensor unit equation
statement: Let c be an OpenTensorPresentation of abelian categories A,B and adj:c.E⊣c.R [def-sf-generic-open-tensor-presentation, def-weil-exact-derived-adjunction]. Assume its total comparison satisfies F_total(η_P,id) Ρ_(EP,T)^(-1) R_complex(Γ_(P,T))=η_(F_total(P,RT)) for flat P,T; assume the A-model is natural for (η_P,id), and every object of each derived category is isomorphic to Q of a c.flatA or c.flatB complex. Then the supplied c.gamma has adjoint transpose c.DA(η_M,id) followed by c.restriction.inv at (EM,N), for all derived inputs M,N: OpenTensorUnitNormalization holds.

source.place: Exact localization of adjunctions (015F) and transport of the open comparison through its specified representative squares

proof.text: For flat P,T, form α from DA(QP,RQT) to Q(TA(P,RT)) using the exact R-factor and modelA; form β from DB(EQP,QT) to Q(TB(EP,T)) using the exact E-factor and modelB; form δ using both exact factors and the modelA of REP,RT.

The representative square identifies gamma.hom followed by E(α) and its exact E-factor with β followed by Q(totalGamma). Naturality and the restriction model square identify rho.hom followed by δ with R(β), its exact R-factor, and Q(totalRestriction).

The localized exact adjunction unit composed with R of the E-factor and then the R-factor is Q of the termwise unit. The assumed model naturality therefore identifies DA(η,id) followed by δ with α followed by Q of the tensor-unit map.

Expand the transpose using the unit. Postcompose with R(gamma.hom) and with the invertible model/factor composite. Substitute the two model squares and the preceding unit identity. The resulting equation is exactly Q of the assumed total equation. Cancel the invertible postcompositions to prove normalization on representatives.

Both sides are natural transformations from TA(M,RN) to R(TB(EM,N)). Choose the assumed representative isomorphisms in both variables. Their image under the source functor is invertible, so naturality and cancellation transport the representative equality to arbitrary derived objects.

lean.statement:
theorem unit_normalization
    (htotal : ∀ P T, c.flatA P → c.flatB T →
      (c.TA.map ((adj.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app P)).app
          ((c.R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj T) ≫
        (c.totalRestriction ((c.E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) T).inv ≫
        (c.R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map (c.totalGamma P T).hom =
      (adj.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app
        ((c.TA.obj P).obj ((c.R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj T)))
    (hnat : ∀ P T (hP : c.flatA P) (hT : c.flatB T),
      c.DA.map (Prod.mkHom
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map ((adj.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app P))
          (𝟙 (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((c.R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj T)))) ≫
        (c.modelA _ _ (c.hR _ (c.hE P hP)) (c.hR T hT)).hom =
      (c.modelA P _ hP (c.hR T hT)).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((c.TA.map ((adj.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app P)).app
          ((c.R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj T)))
    (hA : ∀ M : DerivedCategory A,
      ∃ P : CochainComplex A ℤ, c.flatA P ∧ Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ M))
    (hB : ∀ N : DerivedCategory B,
      ∃ T : CochainComplex B ℤ, c.flatB T ∧ Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj T ≅ N)) :
    OpenTensorUnitNormalization c.E.mapDerivedCategory c.R.mapDerivedCategory
      c.DA c.DB adj.mapExactDerivedCategory c.restriction c.gamma
